t_advice_summary_textbox.text: green, yellow, orange, and blue gnomes will take you to one forest. the other colours will take you to another. keep going to the same forest until you see the count of mushrooms start to decrease, and then switch to another forest.

vb_textbox.text: green, yellow, orange, and blue gnomes take you to the same forest. the other colours (i.e., red, purple, pink) will take you to another. click to go to the same forest consistently until you see the number of mushrooms drop low, to 3,2,1,or even zero. then, switch it up and click to go to the other forest. and repeat
